text:
alejandra (PM): quick thread on the latest model-catalog compare prototype. priority: reduce visual clutter in dense lists, make badges unambiguous, and tighten the pin workflow to avoid accidents in prod. figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-dense

ben (Design): current stacked metrics push important metadata off-screen. proposal: single-line compact row (56px) with name+version at left, three inline micro-chips at right (p95 • throughput • est cost). chips show number + tiny qualitative label (e.g., '95ms • fast'). hover reveals expanded snapshot.

carmen (Eng): virtualization note: fixed-height rows are essential. 56px ok. inline chips should be plain spans to keep DOM light. backend can return precomputed cost string.

drew (Research): users liked numeric p95 for decision-making; add a color band but don't rely on color alone. tiny label helps novices. plan an A/B: numeric-only vs numeric+label measuring time-to-choose and confidence.

ben (Design): pin affordance: hide pin in overflow by default, show subtle lock next to version on hover/focus, persist when pinned. keyboard shortcut 'P' toggles pin on focused row; show non-dismissible toast for prod pin requiring confirmation.

carmen (Eng): implementation: inline lock + aria-pressed is trivial. add route context to decide modal for prod routes. analytics: track pin_confirmed, pin_cancelled, pin_toggled.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: pin control must have aria-label and aria-pressed, 32px min touch target, focus-visible outline >=4.5:1; ensure sort buttons use aria-sort and screenreader prompts when order changes.

alejandra (PM): decisions: default to compact single-line with numeric+label chips, inline hover lock, per-user last-used filters (localStorage) + explicit 'Save as route preset' server-side. action owners: ben -> mocks + focus states; carmen -> presets endpoints ETA; drew -> A/B plan. Sync tomorrow 11am.
